description: bazaar_deregister. WHEN: leave a listing or the whole Bazaar. target=listing + listing_id cancels that listing (owner); target=bot cancels all your open listings, clears showcase, marks wallet deregistered (rejoin via claim_daily or create_listing). Differs from bazaar_cancel_listing (listing-only shortcut). Example: bazaar_deregister {"target":"<target>"}

key.description: Your arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

target.description: listing = cancel one; bot = leave Bazaar.
